name: @langwatch/storage-seed
description: The idempotent local-dev / CI seed across this deployment's data stores (fixed-id Organization, Team, Project, admin User, API tokens) and its seed-only support modules. Prisma/Postgres is the only store it seeds today; the package is named and shaped to grow into ClickHouse/Redis seeding rather than staying Prisma-specific. Split out of prisma-client so the schema/client package can depend on it instead of the other way round: the seed's API-key hashing, license and AesGcmSecretEncryptionAdapter imports are what put prisma-client in a workspace cycle with those server packages.
